changes.before: Sprinting, dashing, and running toward a near-death ally consume no stamina. Restores stamina equal to 50% of the rescue value you apply.
changes.after: Sprinting, dashing, and running toward a near-death ally consume no stamina. Every full segment of rescue you contribute restores 40 stamina. After 5 seconds without contributing rescue, accumulated progress decays by 0.75 segments per second.
